summary: Titan Mining Corp filed a Form 6-K furnishing a quarterly operations and financial results press release for Q2 2026. The release highlights revenue growth, adjusted EBITDA increase, production figures, cost improvements, and balance sheet deleveraging. It also updates on U.S. Army conditional selection notices for graphite purification plant development and EXIM Bank financing interest. No special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is announced; the filing is routine earnings disclosure.
